subject: ela
intro: Interpret idioms, adages, and word relationships.

items.prompt:
The idiom 'break the ice' means to:
A) smash frozen water
B) start a conversation / ease tension
C) feel cold
items.answer: B) start a conversation / ease tension

solution.answer: B) start a conversation / ease tension

items.prompt:
A synonym for 'big' is:
A) large
B) small
C) blue

An antonym for 'happy' is:
A) glad
B) sad
C) joyful

The proverb 'Look before you leap' teaches you to:
A) jump quickly
B) think carefully before acting
C) never try new things

The idiom 'under the weather' means someone feels:
A) sick
B) excited
C) tall

A homograph is a word that is:
A) spelled the same but has different meanings
B) always a synonym
C) always an antonym
items.answer: A) spelled the same but has different meanings

solution.answer: A) spelled the same but has different meanings

items.prompt:
The adage 'Don't count your chickens before they hatch' warns you NOT to:
A) raise chickens
B) assume success before it actually happens
C) count at all
items.answer: B) assume success before it actually happens

solution.answer: B) assume success before it actually happens
